**NET-TOOLS 0.5.0**: a Dutch interface, three new LAN tools, a world map for worldwide results
and export to CSV / PDF. 125 tools in total.

## Highlights

- **Nederlands**: the whole interface, including tool names and descriptions, in Dutch. Switch
  with the NL / UK button in the top bar; numbers follow the language (decimal comma in Dutch).
- **New LAN tools** (LAN mode, Linux):
  - **LLDP / CDP neighbours** — which switch and port the server is plugged into.
  - **IPv6 neighbours & routers** — NDP scan plus router advertisements: prefixes, SLAAC or
    DHCPv6, DNS servers, search domains, MTU.
  - **DHCPv6 probe** — finds every DHCPv6 server (rogue DHCPv6 check); never takes a lease.
- **World map** of the probe locations for every Worldwide (Globalping) result. The map is
  bundled; no external tile service is contacted.
- **Export**: every result table downloads as CSV; every tool prints or saves as PDF.
- **Azure** Service Tags in the cloud / CDN IP lookup (service and region).
- **Audit log** (`AUDIT_LOG=true`, off by default): one line per server-tool request, client IP
  hashed with `LOG_HASH_IPS`, request bodies never logged.
- Favicon, logo and loading screen follow the accent colour; subtitle "Tools for Networkers".
- The "New" badge now marks only tools added since the previous release.

## Fixes

- Choice buttons (DNS lookup "Run from", HTTP status classes, URL parser, WireGuard routing) ran
  off the screen on phones; they now wrap.
- Local builds (`make up`) show the git version instead of `dev`.

## Upgrade

```bash
cd net-tools-docker
git pull
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```

The LAN tools need the LAN override (`docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.lan.yml up -d`)
and still only `NET_RAW`. No configuration changes are required.

Images:

- `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-web:0.5.0`
- `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-api:0.5.0`

Both come with an SBOM and build provenance. Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/digibaro/net-tools-docker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Known limitations

- Mobile Lighthouse performance stays below 90 (pre-rendering planned).
- `METRICS_ENABLED` is accepted but no metrics endpoint exists yet.
- LLDP / CDP only hear something when the host is plugged into a switch that announces itself;
  inside a VM you usually see the hypervisor at most.
- SNMP was tested against an in-process agent, not yet against real devices.
